rounds.prompt: How many oranges would it take to weigh as much as an adult male orangutan?
rounds.source: San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance orangutan fact sheet: adult males weigh about 87 kg (192 lb) · USDA FoodData Central, Oranges, raw, with peel (FDC 169919): 1 fruit = 159 g

rounds.prompt: How many people holding hands would it take to circle the outside of the Colosseum in Rome?
rounds.source: Colosseum dimensions (189 × 156 m, original perimeter 545 m) per Wikipedia and World History Encyclopedia, with 1.5 m of line per person hand to hand

rounds.prompt: How many atoms thick is a sheet of standard kitchen aluminum foil?
rounds.source: Reynolds Kitchens foil FAQ (standard foil 0.016 mm thick) · aluminum crystal lattice measurements (Arblaster 2018, lattice constant 404.93 pm)
